note: Ordinary read-only reviewer task in the registered physical checkout. The reviewer uses Git directly to inspect the current changes; no Git or snapshot binding is sent.

task.goal: Review the current Git changes, including staged, unstaged and untracked files. Report findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding states a file/line reference, impact and reason.
Confirmed findings are delivered in the findings artifact.
task.context: Read-only review in your registered physical checkout. Inspect Git directly and read relevant files. Do not modify, stage or commit. Report findings first with file/line, impact and reason.
checks: List findings with file/line, impact and reason; state explicitly what could not be verified.
